# School Setup - Institutional Infrastructure & B2B Solutions

> School Setup (https://www.school-setup.com/) is a direct institutional manufacturer and turnkey infrastructure provider in India. We plan, fabricate, deliver, and install heavy-duty classroom school furniture, preschool and daycare activity setups, commercial playground equipment, and outdoor open fitness gyms across Uttar Pradesh and pan-India.

## Core Solutions & Product Lines

- [School & Classroom Furniture](https://www.school-setup.com/school-furniture/): Heavy-duty 14–16 gauge CRCA steel student dual desks, single benches, teacher tables, library stacks, science lab workbenches, and administrative storage cabinets complying with BIS IS 4837 standards.
- [Preschool & Kids Furniture](https://www.school-setup.com/kids-furniture/): Non-toxic, food-grade virgin polypropylene activity tables (flower, round, kidney shapes), stackable preschool chairs, Montessori cubby storage units, and early childhood reading corners.
- [Commercial Playground Equipment](https://www.school-setup.com/playground-equipment/): Multi-activity play systems (MPS), heavy-duty spiral and wave slides, A-frame swing sets, seesaws, spring riders, and shock-absorbing EPDM / rubber tile safety flooring.
- [Outdoor Gym Equipment](https://www.school-setup.com/outdoor-gym-equipment/): Public park and campus outdoor fitness stations constructed with 114mm OD Class-B galvanized iron (GI) pipes, sealed 6204/6305 anti-friction bearings, and pure polyester UV-resistant powder coating. Includes Air Walkers, Chest Press / Lat Pull Combos, Leg Presses, and Cross Trainers.
- [Complete Turnkey School Setup](https://www.school-setup.com/complete-school-setup/): Single-source procurement covering campus spatial planning, itemized Bill of Quantities (BOQ), direct batch manufacturing, dedicated road logistics, and on-site assembly.
- [School Infrastructure Solutions](https://www.school-setup.com/school-infrastructure/): Turnkey institutional expansion services for newly accredited CBSE, ICSE, and state board campuses.

## Regional Operational Footprint

Direct manufacturing dispatch, localized transport logistics, and on-site assembly crews serve educational institutions, park developers, and housing societies across Uttar Pradesh:

- [Lucknow Operational Hub](https://www.school-setup.com/school-furniture-lucknow/): Serving Gomti Nagar, Shaheed Path, Aliganj, Hazratganj, and Lucknow Municipal Corporation (LMC/LDA) park tenders.
- [Ayodhya Operational Hub](https://www.school-setup.com/school-furniture-ayodhya/): Serving Faizabad, Devkali, Ram Janmabhoomi corridor developments, and expanding regional school campuses.
- [Sultanpur Operational Hub](https://www.school-setup.com/school-furniture-sultanpur/): Serving Civil Lines, Golaghat, Lambhua, Kadipur, and Musafirkhana institutions.
- Complete regional directories: [Service Locations](https://www.school-setup.com/locations/)

## In-Depth Institutional Knowledge & Procurement Manuals

- [How to Start a Play School in India (2026 Guide)](https://www.school-setup.com/blog/how-to-start-a-play-school-in-india/): Itemized capital budgets (₹8–18 Lakhs), space blueprints, childproofing norms, and independent vs franchise analysis.
- [Outdoor Open Gym Equipment Setup Guide](https://www.school-setup.com/blog/outdoor-open-gym-equipment-setup-guide/): 114mm OD GI pipe engineering, M20 450mm concrete foundations, bearing specifications, and safety zones.
- [School Furniture Buying Guide](https://www.school-setup.com/blog/school-furniture-buying-guide/): BIS IS 4837 Class 1–6 anthropometric sizing matrix, 16-gauge CRCA steel specs, and tender compliance checklist.
- [Knowledge Hub](https://www.school-setup.com/blog/): Institutional guides and campus architecture resources.
